steps.title: Culture P. patens
steps.instruction: Grow a colony culture on BCD (AT) medium for 15 days in a square box (10 x 10 cm).

steps.title: Prepare aniline blue working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the aniline blue stock solution 1:3 (v:v) in phosphate buffer pH 8.5.

steps.title: Stain protonema tissues
steps.instruction: Stain the protonema samples using aniline blue working solution.

substeps.instruction: Fill the wells of a 48-well plate with 200µL of the aniline blue working solution.
Collect a small amount of protonema from the periphery of the colonies and place them into the wells.
Incubate the tissues in the solution for 30 minutes at 23°C in the dark.

steps.title: Mount samples
steps.instruction: Place the samples on a slide containing propidium iodide and apply a coverslip.

steps.title: Configure confocal microscope
steps.instruction: Set up the Leica TCS SP8 microscope with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Lasers: Laser diode UV 405 nm (callose) at 10%; Laser visible 488 nm (PI) at 9% to 15%.
Detectors: PMT 2 (callose) gain 670, offset 0.1%, 440-520 nm; PMT 4 (chloroplast autofluorescence) gain 550, offset 0.1%, 600-720 nm; PI 560-615 nm.
Acquisition: Zoom 1.5, Pinhole airy 1, Frame average 8, Scan speed 8,000 hz, Image definition 1024x1024, 12 bit.
Wavelengths: Aniline blue λ ex 390 nm / λ em 480 nm; PI λ ex 493 nm / λ em 636 nm.

steps.title: Acquire images
steps.instruction: Locate and capture images of the cell walls.

substeps.instruction: Locate the sample on the slide using x5 magnification (air).
Observe the entire sample at x25 then x40 magnification (water).
Define 30 tiles with a spacing of 0.70.
Acquire images of the wall between the apical cell and the sub-apical cell (50 biological replicates).

steps.title: Process images
steps.instruction: Process the acquired z-stacks to prepare for quantification.

substeps.instruction: Use the maximum projection function on z-stacks to obtain the final image.
Duplicate the images (shortcut cmd + shift + D).
Set the minimum displayed value to 0 and maximum displayed value to 4095 (12 bit).

steps.title: Quantify callose signal
steps.instruction: Measure the fluorescence intensity using the ROI manager (Analyze > Tools > ROI Manager).

substeps.instruction: Open ROI T1 (model 360 µm²) in the ROI manager.

Move the ROI to a corner with no signal and measure the sum of pixel intensities (Analyze > Set Measurements > check Integrated Density; Analyze > Measure [ctrl + m] RawIntDens) to determine the background noise signal.
Position the ROI at the wall between the apical and sub-apical cells and measure the sum of pixel intensities to determine the raw callose signal.
Calculate the final callose signal: Raw callose signal – background noise signal.
Repeat this process for all samples.

steps.title: Visualize data
steps.instruction: Create a box plot of the different treated conditions to visualize the data.
